sb_skinners_trophy_cords.accept_text: Blackthorn Ridge is the dark line north of my post. The skinners work its near slope, the side facing us. Take the cords off them, and look for the bell.

sb_the_boarhound_pack.accept_text: North of here, on Blackthorn Ridge. The hounds run its western end, and the stalkers lie up in the thorns behind them.

sb_eyes_on_the_gate.accept_text: Bael'dun Keep is the wall west of this grass. The gate you want is on its east side, the side facing us. Walk up, look, come back.

sb_cut_the_fuse.accept_text: West of here, along the charge-line that runs up to the Keep's east gate. The experts wear red hats. Take the charges off them.

sb_ironvein.accept_text: Bael'dun Keep, west of this grass. He walks the east wall, the one facing us, among his sergeants. Listen for the hammer.

sb_seed_and_thorn.accept_text: Razorfen Kraul. Its mouth is south of my post, where the thorn closes over the road. The geomancers work the ground just inside, on their knees.

sb_the_vine_bridge.accept_text: Inside Razorfen Kraul, south of my post. Take the vine bridge west of the first fork. Roogug holds the platform beyond it.

sb_two_speakers.accept_text: Razorfen Kraul again, south of here. The Thorn Court lies north of the fork inside. Aggem keeps the west of it and Jargba the east.

sb_the_beast_pit.accept_text: Down in Razorfen Kraul, south of my post. The warded neck is north-west of the pens. Break the stones first, then go in after Agathelos.

sb_razorflank.accept_text: Razorfen Kraul, south of here, and all the way up it. Charlga holds the bone platform at the top, with her totemics around her.

sb_blind_hunter.accept_text: Razorfen Kraul, south of my post. He keeps the west gallery, past Aggem's pen, and his handlers keep him.
